title: Cripple walls.
officialText: Foundation cripple walls shall be framed of studs not less in size than the studding above with a minimum length of 14 inches (356mm), or shall be framed of solid blocking. Where exceeding 4 feet (1219 mm) in height, such walls shall be framed of studs having the size required for an additional story.
